datasets.title: Kenya - Georeferenced Sectorial data for Sotik and Chepalungu Subcounties of Bomet County
datasets.description: This is primary data collected using kobo toolbox in the two sub-counties for data readiness support in the Community Epidemic and Pandemic Preparedness (CP3) Program. Involved in the data collection are mainly; the Community Health Volunteers, the administration team, and the Animal Health Assistants.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/georeferenced-sectorial-data-for-sotik-and-chepalungu-subcounties-of-bomet-county]

contact_point.name: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC)

creator.name: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC)

lineage.description: Primary data collected through direct observation using KoboToolbox in Sotik and Chepalungu subcounties by IFRC-coordinated teams including Community Health Volunteers and local administration. Data covers nine sectorial categories (health, education, agriculture, water, sanitation, trade, transport, worship, and public amenities) georeferenced for epidemic and pandemic preparedness planning.

sources.name: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC)
sources.description: Primary georeferenced sectorial data collected via KoboToolbox by Community Health Volunteers, administration teams, and Animal Health Assistants for the Community Epidemic and Pandemic Preparedness (CP3) Program in Bomet County.

resources.title: Places of worship.csv
resources.description: This dataset entails Churches in Sotik and Chepalungu Sub counties of Bomet County

resources.title: Trade and Finance.csv
resources.description: This dataset entails amongst other business-related amenities, Tea Collection centers, Open Air markets/Shopping Centers, Abattoirs, and Butcheries in Sotik and Chepalungu Sub counties of Bomet County

resources.title: Transport and Migration.csv
resources.description: This dataset entails Inter and Intra-country Border Crossing Points, Migratory Routes in Sotik and Chepalungu Sub counties of Bomet County

resources.title: Water & Irrigation.csv
resources.description: This dataset entails Earth Dam/Water Pans, Boreholes, Community water storage tanks, Water Distribution Kiosks, Springs, Streams, and Water Distribution Taps in Sotik and Chepalungu Sub counties of Bomet County

resources.title: Sanitation.csv
resources.description: This dataset entails Hand Washing Stations, Waste disposal pits, and public toilets, in Sotik and Chepalungu Sub counties of Bomet County

resources.title: Public Amenities .csv
resources.description: This dataset entails the Administrative Offices e.g Chief's office, Bodaboda Shelter, Government Facilities e.g Ministry, Kamukunji /Meeting Point, Library, Playground, Police Post, Social Hall, Stadium in Sotik and Chepalungu Sub counties of Bomet County

resources.title: Agriculture and Livestock.csv
resources.description: This dataset entails Livestock Holding Centers (Crushes), Cattle dips, Animal watering points, and Special farms e.g Bee keeping in Sotik and Chepalungu Sub counties of Bomet County

resources.title: Health.csv
resources.description: This dataset entails health facilities' (Dispensaries, clinics, health centers, and chemist) locations, operation status, availability of electricity as well as the services offered in Sotik and Chepalungu Subcounties of Bomet County

resources.title: Education.csv
resources.description: This dataset entails Pre-primary, Primary, Secondary, Vocational, and Tertiary levels of education in Sotik and Chepalungu Subcounties of Bomet County

Water and irrigation infrastructure, sanitation facilities, and transportation networks in the study area
Agricultural and livestock production facilities and assets
